description.value:
You surround yourself with a biotic field and launch forward in a devastating dash, crashing into enemies with tremendous impact force. You move up to 60 feet in a straight line towards an enemy you can see, so long as that enemy does not have total cover, phasing through any obstacles in your path. That target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.classDC.value)|basic|options:me-power:me-biotic-charge] save against your class DC. The target takes @Damage[(1+ceil(@actor.system.details.level.value/2))d6[bludgeoning]] damage: 2d6 at 1st level, +1d6 at 3rd level and every 2 levels after.

Whatever the target rolls, your Biotic Barrier recharges half its maximum HP.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success Half damage.

Failure Full damage, and the target is knocked prone.

Critical Failure Double damage, knocked prone, and pushed 5 feet away from you. Your Biotic Barrier recharges to full.

Cooldown: 2 rounds (1 round with Improved Charge).

When a creature rolls the save above, the result for its degree of success is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).

Target one creature before you use Charge and it runs itself: you move to the open space beside the target, the target rolls its Reflex save, a critical failure pushes it 5 feet, and the cooldown starts (see the Automate Vanguard Powers setting; a GM must be connected).
